The <b>Mosslands</b> are a pair of areas in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. The [[Map and Quill (Silksong)#Maps|Map]] of both areas is bought from [[Shakra]] as a single map named Mosslands, and both areas have separate Quick Maps; when zoomed-out, the map groups up both areas in one map which is (somewhat erroneously) labelled Bone Bottom.

}}

==Trivia==
*Both Mosslands areas are the only areas in the game to share a map colour; they are both the same shade of green.
